statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Tail remains elevated after a sustained Nasdaq decline into the close; the current CME maintenance interval limits fresh path evidence.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. The next evidence checkpoint is the 00:00 Berlin Globex reopening, with de-escalation contingent on meaningful retracements and cross-asset stabilization.
headline: Late-session downside persists into CME maintenance
body: Nasdaq closed about 1% lower as the U.S. 10-year yield returned near 4.70% and oil stayed above $93. The latest shared Finviz context was fresh and supporting-only, showing 7 of 8 tracked megacaps negative, delayed NQ -0.66%, VIX futures +1.10% and WTI +2.64%. Semiconductor breadth was mixed, which limits Tail escalation.

lookbackSummary: Over the prior 24 hourly assessments, Tail moved from low post-FOMC readings to WATCH around Thursday's data and cash open, then rose above the block threshold as Nasdaq weakness re-extended into the close.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours begin with CME maintenance and the 00:00 Berlin Globex reopening. Conditional Tail is highest around reopening, then decays if two-sided trade returns. Friday's U.S. cash open and 16:00 Berlin state employment release are the main later checkpoints.

forecast.analysis: CME equity-index futures are in the daily maintenance interval. The latest cash-session evidence remains downside-aligned: Nasdaq closed about 1% lower with 10-year yields near 4.70%, Brent above $93 and volatility firmer.
drivers: CME maintenance limits fresh NQ path evidence

forecast.analysis: Overnight Tail stays just above the threshold only if the reopening preserves directional efficiency. Broader retracement or lower volatility would shift the regime toward WATCH.
The forecast moves to WATCH if overnight price discovery becomes more two-sided. Elevated oil and yields remain stress amplifiers, but future one-way continuation is not assumed.
Tail eases further if overnight pullbacks become meaningful and repeated extension does not appear. Stress remains extreme because the geopolitical and rates backdrop is unresolved.
Early European hours are modeled as WATCH unless a fresh directional extension emerges. The key distinction is whether NQ can rotate away from the prior cash-session lows.
Risk continues to decay conditionally if European trade remains balanced and oil or yields do not trigger renewed technology pressure. No future continuation is treated as observed.
The morning forecast remains WATCH at the lower boundary. Persistent geopolitical stress keeps the environment difficult, but Tail needs fresh directional efficiency to rise again.
Approaching the European midday window, Tail stays at WATCH if the overnight session shows usable mean reversion. A renewed yield-led technology selloff would invalidate this decay.
European morning risk stays at the lower WATCH boundary if the overnight session preserves usable mean reversion. Fresh yield-led technology pressure would invalidate that stability.
Through 10:00 Berlin, Tail remains WATCH at the lower boundary if NQ stays rotational. Geopolitical stress remains high, but future continuation is not treated as observed.
Tail edges higher as European trade matures and U.S. premarket participation approaches. The recent trend-down regime remains relevant but needs fresh path confirmation.
Around 12:00 Berlin, risk remains below block if price discovery is balanced. Long yields and oil remain the main cross-asset channels capable of reviving technology pressure.
U.S. premarket risk rises modestly. Friday's state employment release is still hours away, so event proximity lifts Stress more than Tail at this stage.
The final pre-open hour carries higher gap and continuation risk. Tail remains WATCH because the direction and retracement quality of the cash-session move are not yet observed.
U.S. cash-open price discovery is the main checkpoint. Tail reaches the top of WATCH conditionally; escalation requires actual opening-auction continuation with shallow or failed retracements.
State Employment and Unemployment is scheduled at 16:00 Berlin. Tail stays at the top of WATCH because the release is a catalyst, not proof of a persistent price path.
drivers: State Employment and Unemployment at 16:00 Berlin

forecast.analysis: After the state employment release, Tail decays conditionally if the market absorbs the data with two-sided trade. A fresh trend-down leg would prevent that normalization.
Late-morning U.S. risk remains elevated but below block if price discovery stabilizes. Oil and long yields remain background amplifiers rather than automatic Tail signals.
Midday conditions are modeled as more rotational unless the prior downside regime reasserts itself. Tail remains sensitive to renewed megacap and breadth alignment.
Early afternoon remains below block if meaningful retracements persist. Repeated extension after failed pullbacks would invalidate this decay and restore elevated Tail.
Risk rises into the U.S. power hour because late-session continuation mattered during the recent selloff. Tail remains WATCH unless one-way structure is actually observed.
The cash-close hour is a conditional continuation checkpoint. Tail reaches 24% because a weak Friday close could extend the recent regime, but direction is not assumed in advance.

forecastDetail.comment: CME maintenance removes live NQ price discovery; the latest cash-session trend remains downside-aligned.
Globex reopening is the next direct test of whether the prior selloff preserves shallow-retracement structure.
Elevated Tail persists conditionally only if early reopening trade resists meaningful mean reversion.
Overnight Tail stays just above block while directional efficiency remains unresolved.
Risk moves to WATCH if reopening price discovery becomes clearly two-sided.
Further decay is conditional on meaningful retracements and no renewed cross-asset downside alignment.
